request.subject: PORTRAIT:UNDEAD:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Turn it into a drowned ghost galley submarine: remove the mast, the sail and the rag; the hull becomes long, low and closed, of the same near-black wood with pale grey barnacle studs, the ivory bone rail and a skull on the bow; on deck a low humped black cabin with a row of windows glowing bright violet; one small violet lantern on a short crooked pole. Keep the size, thick black outline and art style the same, on a transparent background.
